proof_summary: An explicit two-generator group \(P\) of order \(3^6\), with relations \(a^{27}=1\), \(b^{-1}ab=a^4\), and \(b^{27}=a^9\), has exactly \(3^7\) automorphisms by counting the admissible generating image-pairs of \(a,b\). The coprime direct product \(C_2\times P\) has the same automorphism group because both factors are characteristic and \(\operatorname{Aut}(C_2)\) is trivial, but its order is \(2\cdot3^6\), giving the counterexample.
